mentions.name: The Curiosity Times
mentions.description: This is a monthly printed newspaper for kids, delivered on real newsprint, packed with puzzles, math challenges, nature facts, science experiments, outdoor scavenger hunts, and custom card/board games for families to play together. It was created to give kids hours of engaging, educational, screen-free activity each month.
mentions.problem: The author wanted something to keep kids busy for hours each month that isn't on a screen, is educational, and is fun, as part of a household goal of limiting screen time.
mentions.audience: Kids and families looking for screen-free educational entertainment
